tools.name: search_products
tools.title: Search products
tools.description: Search the BF SUMA Royal supplement catalog by keyword. Returns matching active products with name, slug, price (KES), benefit, and stock status.

query.description: Keyword to match against product name, benefit, or description. Use empty string to list all.

tools.name: get_product
tools.title: Get product details
tools.description: Fetch a single BF SUMA Royal product by its URL slug (e.g. 'arthroxtra'). Returns full description, price (KES), benefit, PV value, and stock.

slug.description: Product slug as it appears in the URL after /product/.

tools.name: list_wellness_hubs
tools.title: List wellness hubs
tools.description: List all active wellness hub pages (health goal categories such as Joint Pain, Sleep & Recovery). Returns name, slug, and hero description.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.title: List blog posts
tools.description: List published BF SUMA Royal blog posts. Returns title, slug, excerpt, and published date. Newest first.
